title: Kiritani Haruka — Profile Story

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Next, it's my turn.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'd like to take this opportunity to once again thank you all for watching...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: No matter how far, may this song of hope reach you!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm Haruka Kiritani from MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
As for my self-intro...
What should I talk about?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm sure many of you are aware that I used to be a member of a group called ASRUN...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Unfortunately, something happened that prevented me from performing on stage... Which led to me retiring for a time.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: However, I was able to return to being an idol with the help of the others from MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We've had to overcome quite a lot after deciding to go it alone instead of looking for an agency to sign with. There's definitely been a lot of trial and error...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But now, we get to interact with all of you through your comments, and at events in real life...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Looking back, I think we've had more fun moments than tough ones.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Our solo show in particular. I'm never going to forget the smiles I saw that day.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We've been appearing on TV and magazines a lot more recently because of all the support you've given us, but that has led to us doing fewer events in real life...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I really want to see you all more, so I hope you'll be looking forward to our future events!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Anyway, MORE MORE JUMP! is still just getting started, so we hope that you'll keep watching as we continue our journey.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Streams, shows, TV shoots...
We're going to keep doing all those things.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We're going to keep spreading as much hope as we can to all of you, so we'll be looking forward to your continued support.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hmm... That sounded a little too serious.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But that's how I really feel, and I'm glad I got this chance to tell all of you.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hehe...
Minori says, “We heard you loud and clear!”

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Oh, and so many comments.
Thank you all very much!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We're sorry about not being able to respond to all of them since they really fly by now...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But we always go through them afterwards, so please keep sending us your thoughts.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Anyway, thanks for listening!
Next up is...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Your wait is over, everyone!
Airi, take it away!
